name: Pine Ridge (2v2)
_doc: A 2v2 winter map (P3-23b), 384x384 m: two allied bases on the west, two on the east. Pine forests split the ground into a northern and a southern lane and a central valley, where a logging village and a data center on the middle line sit. Allies share a supply site between their bases. Mirrored across x = 192 (terrain_gen.mirror_x makes the heights exact). Start positions: west north, east north, west south, east south, so player n starts at start n (teams 1 and 3 west, 2 and 4 east).
_terrain_doc: height.r16 is built from terrain_gen by tools/make_heightmap.py: snowy hills, and pine stands raised a little above the snow. No water.
_obstacles_doc: Pine forests [x_m, y_m, w_m, h_m], west side first, then their mirrors.
_civilian_doc: Logging village houses [x_m, y_m, w_m, h_m, roof_height_m] (P3-05), west side first, then their mirrors.
_neutral_doc: Capturable neutral buildings [building_id, x_m, y_m] (P3-08a), west side first, then mirrors, then the data center on the middle line.
_supply_doc: Per base a safe site; per team a shared one between the bases and two forward ones near the lanes.
